title: Amazon S3 bucket replication
description: This pattern sets up replication between S3 buckets.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern sets up S3 replication between two buckets. The replication configuration is set up in the source bucket, and the destination bucket is set up to receive the replicated objects. The replication configuration is set up to replicate all objects in the source bucket to the destination bucket.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
